name: boxis
description: Claude's answers in colour-coded boxes by type (decision, warning, scope, test, wrap-up). Uses the Skins theme on the inside when Skins is on (optional). A check per box and an "all" button on the last answer. Pin a box (⚲) to list it in a Pins pane and jump back to it; /boxis pins opens the list. /boxis opens the mod's own colour panel.
